question: Will Acme Corp publicly announce layoffs affecting 5% or more of its workforce before September 30, 2026?
description: This market resolves based on official public communications by Acme Corp: press releases, SEC filings, or statements by named executives, reported by at least two major news outlets.
resolutionRules: Resolves YES if, before 23:59 ET on 2026-09-30, Acme Corp officially announces a reduction in force affecting at least 5% of its global workforce. Leaks or anonymous reports do not count until officially confirmed. Resolves NO otherwise.
